summary: Tested Series Cast enrichment (episode_count per cast, recurring guest-star promotion at threshold=5), collection_ids parity on GET /api/series/{id}, and the frontend SeriesDetail rendering + Recurring badge. All 7 backend tests pass; UI verified with a seeded 6-episode series (lead + guest both show '6 Episodes'; only guest card shows RECURRING badge). Test seed data was cleaned up at module teardown and after the UI run.

issues: 'N Episodes' uses text-slate-500 on #14181f which is quite low-contrast; consider text-slate-400 for better WCAG AA on the recurring/episode subline.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py enrich_series: logic is correct and well-scoped. Minor: when the same actor is a guest star AND in main_cast, their original character_name is preserved (good). gs_character stores first-seen character_name only — acceptable but worth documenting.
SeriesDetail.jsx cast card contrast on '{N} Episodes' subline is low (text-slate-500 on near-black). Non-blocking but a quick a11y win.
VideosSection.jsx now wraps the player in a Dialog with sr-only DialogTitle + DialogDescription — resolves the Radix a11y warning.
seed_data_creation: Created transient actors/series/collections prefixed with TEST_ via API in both pytest fixtures and the playwright UI test; all cleaned up at teardown (DELETE /api/series/{id}, /api/actors/{id}, /api/collections/{id}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_series_cast.py covers: collection_ids parity on GET /api/series/{id}, episode_count on original main_cast equals series total, guest-star promotion at threshold=6 (>=5) with Recurring flag, no promotion at 4 episodes (<5), no duplication when actor is both lead and guest, and ordering (originals in input order then recurring sorted desc by episode_count). The UI check seeds a 6-ep series and asserts the [data-testid=series-cast-{id}] + [data-testid=series-cast-episode-count-{id}] + Recurring badge.
